title: Volume Pricing Rate Card for ProBuild Tiers
content:
Volume pricing under Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards is quoted against a per-tier rate card: a smallest pre-tax order for which a quote may be requested, a ladder of discount ceilings by order size, a list of departments never volume priced, a largest number of lines on one quote, and a largest number of quotes in requested or priced status at once.

## Order size, lines and open quotes

| Tier | Smallest pre-tax order for which a volume pricing quote may be requested | Most lines on one quote | Most quotes in requested or priced status at once |
|---|---|---|---|
| ProBuild Member | USD 2500.00 | 50 | 3 |
| ProBuild Bronze | USD 2500.00 | 75 | 5 |
| ProBuild Silver | USD 2000.00 | 100 | 10 |
| ProBuild Gold | USD 1500.00 | 150 | 15 |
| ProBuild Platinum | USD 1000.00 | 250 | 25 |
| ProBuild Platinum Elite | USD 1000.00 | 500 | 40 |

## Discount ceiling ladder

Each step names the quote total from which it applies and the largest discount allowed from that point. The step that applies is the highest step whose order figure the quote total reaches.

| Tier | First step | Second step | Third step |
|---|---|---|---|
| ProBuild Member | from USD 2500.00: up to 2 percent | from USD 10000.00: up to 3 percent | none |
| ProBuild Bronze | from USD 2500.00: up to 3 percent | from USD 10000.00: up to 5 percent | none |
| ProBuild Silver | from USD 2000.00: up to 3 percent | from USD 10000.00: up to 5 percent | from USD 25000.00: up to 7 percent |
| ProBuild Gold | from USD 1500.00: up to 4 percent | from USD 10000.00: up to 7 percent | from USD 25000.00: up to 10 percent |
| ProBuild Platinum | from USD 1000.00: up to 5 percent | from USD 10000.00: up to 8 percent | from USD 25000.00: up to 12 percent |
| ProBuild Platinum Elite | from USD 1000.00: up to 6 percent | from USD 10000.00: up to 10 percent | from USD 25000.00: up to 15 percent |

At ProBuild Member and ProBuild Bronze the ladder has two steps, so the second step remains the highest step reached for any quote total of USD 10000.00 or more.

## Departments never volume priced

At every tier, items from these departments are never volume priced: appliances, gift cards and power tools.

## Reading the ladder (hypothetical quote totals)

| Tier | Hypothetical quote total | Highest step reached | Discount ceiling |
|---|---|---|---|
| ProBuild Gold | USD 9999.99 | first | 4 percent |
| ProBuild Gold | USD 10000.00 | second | 7 percent |
| ProBuild Gold | USD 25000.00 | third | 10 percent |
| ProBuild Member | USD 30000.00 | second | 3 percent |
| ProBuild Silver | USD 1999.99 | none: below the smallest order of USD 2000.00 | no quote may be requested |
